name: 2 Tone
summary: It was characterized by its multiracial bands, its socially conscious lyrics addressing issues of racism and unemployment, and its distinct visual style, which was a revival of the 1960s Rude Boy look.
description: It was characterized by its multiracial bands, its socially conscious lyrics addressing issues of racism and unemployment, and its distinct visual style, which was a revival of the 1960s Rude Boy look. The movement's name comes from 2 Tone Records, the influential record label founded by Jerry Dammers of The Specials, which served as the cultural and musical hub of the scene.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Anti-racism, racial unity, working-class pride, social commentary
